name: Halloween Bonanza

features.name: Pay-anywhere refills
features.description: Win by symbol count; the reels refill after each win.

features.name: Summed multipliers
features.description: Multiple multiplier symbols in one spin are added together.

review:
The refilling-reels engine dressed up for Halloween. It's pay-anywhere, so wins depend on how many matching symbols are on screen.

Four scatters give 10 free spins, five give 20 and six give 30. In the bonus, multiplier symbols worth 2x to 100x add together when several land in one spin. Very high volatility, a 10,197x max and 96.11% RTP. Free spins are rare – roughly once every 398 spins.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus is rare (about 1 in 398 spins on average)
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
